evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: music search/discovery using content identification (fingerprinting) — methods are alternatives/enablers, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: profile-based music search/discovery.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: collaborative/similarity-based music discovery.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: content-similarity based discovery (applies to related content types), not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: metadata/image-tag driven music discovery; enumerated outcomes are attributes of that feature.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Single cohesive feature: upload videos with tags preserved/available for downstream processing (tightly coupled behavior).

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: viewing thumbnail sequences of segments.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: retrieve information about similar items/segments (items vs segments are variants of same feature).

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: obtain info about perceptually similar content; wording lists scope, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: recommendation delivery based on similar profiles.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: geo/ news-based recommendation; a single recommendation capability using a specific signal.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines two independently implementable/prioritizable features: person identification and retrieval/presentation of related information.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines product detection/identification and fetching/displaying related product information — separable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines logo identification and retrieval/presentation of related information; these can be independently implemented/prioritized.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines brand identification and showing related information — two separable features.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: image-based recommendation; input alternatives (take/upload) are methods, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest
evaluations.rationale: Single cohesive feature: map-based/geo discovery and informing users about available content; notification is part of the same capability.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ASR-based content search.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Combines viewing, validation and editing of segmentations — these are independently implementable/testable actions and thus multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Combines manual annotation and automated topic extraction — two separable features that can be implemented and prioritized independently.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering and ranking are distinct operations (different outputs/prioritization) and can be implemented/tested separately — thus not atomic.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: quick tampering/edited-audio assessment.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: nudity prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: prefiltering via low-level asset info.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automatic copyright validation of ingested content.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: prefiltering using high-level metadata/tags (sources enumerated are attributes of same feature).

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: assessing image interest/complexity; multiple data sources are inputs, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detection/prompting rule based on annotations/comments; inputs are enumerated, not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: volunteer type identification/classification.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: image preclassification using low-level features.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect images lacking classifiable animals.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect image series due to timestamp malfunction.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: attribute preclassification (e.g., age, posture) — one capability.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: counting animals in images.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: identify plankton regions (segmentation/localization are alternative technical approaches for same goal).

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect images without classifiable plankton.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: measure plankton attributes (size/orientation are multiple attributes of same detection feature).

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: motion analysis used to shorten/condense video (analysis and intended result are part of same capability).

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: event detection (egg-laying time) in video.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect important disaster-related features (enumerated examples are types of features, not separate stories).

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: weighting/assessing classification confidence based on experience.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: image prefiltering to remove artefacts (examples are attributes of the same task).

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect moving/transient objects (terms describe the same detection capability).

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: audio denoising/background removal.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: clustering/grouping similar whale calls.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: count distinct whales in audio.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect appropriate interruption timing.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: choose interruption modality; options enumerated are modalities for the same decision.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detection/timing for education interventions.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: choose education modality; enumerated media are alternatives within same feature.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: select appropriate educational content.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect interesting comments by volunteers.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: trigger timing for Zoonibot comments.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: determine when Zoonibot should provide explanations.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: determine Zoonibot message content.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: clustering/grouping subjects by similarity.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: personalized project recommendation using experience data.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: provide article summaries for reuse.
